dish.note: Buttered popcorn in paper bags. Statler and Waldorf hated it, then finished the bag.
dish.how: Heat the oil in a large lidded pot with three kernels. When they pop, add the rest of the kernels, cover and shake over the heat until the popping slows. Tip into a bowl, pour over the melted butter, toss with the salt and fill paper bags.
dish.make_ahead: Pop it up to 2 hours ahead and keep it loose in a dry bowl; bag it to serve

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large lidded pot with three kernels until they pop.
Add the rest of the kernels, cover and shake over the heat until the popping slows.
Toss with the melted butter and salt and fill the paper bags.
